title: Seaside Aquarium
specs: Oldest privately owned aquarium on the West Coast
blurb: Guests can feed the seals and see many local sea creatures such as anemones, sea stars, and rockfish. The aquarium is involved in marine education and public awareness programs. It is located on the beach at the end of Second Avenue and North Promenade in Seaside, Oregon.
highlights: Oldest privately owned aquarium on the West Coast
hoursText: Open Daily at 9 a.m. (winter and summer hours may vary at closing time)
